scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),{execFileSync:e}=require('child_process');const w=(d,o=[])=>{for(const x of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,x.name);if(x.isDirectory())w(f,o);else if(f.endsWith('.js'))o.push(f);}return o;};for(const f of ['server.js',...w('src')]){if(f.endsWith('firebaseBackend.js'))continue;e(process.execPath,['-c',f],{stdio:'inherit'});}"
